summary: Simple Copy now creates a regular Custom operation with the standard Custom view provider, so the copied object gets the Custom task panel and Custom icon instead of a property-view-only object; the Custom task panel is also made to expand to the full task-panel height.

pages.reason: Path/Op/Gui/SimpleCopy.py: Activated() now assigns Path.Op.Gui.Base.ViewProvider with the Custom resources (icon CAM_Custom.svg, page Path.Op.Gui.Custom.TaskPanelOpPage) and calls setDeleteObjectsOnReject(False), so the result is an editable Custom op with a task panel (G-code editor, tool controller, coolant) rather than a parameter-only object; the old SimpleCopy-specific ViewProvider is kept solely to migrate objects in old documents on save

Path/Op/Gui/Custom.py: TaskPanelOpPage gains needsFullSpace = True and sets the form and txtGCodeBox vertical size policy to Expanding, so the G-code editor fills the task panel height; no control or behaviour text changes

Path/Dressup/Utils.py: baseOp() switches from name matching to Proxy module check, and Path/Op/Gui/Base.py: needsFullSpace() consults feature pages; both are internal with no documented behaviour change
Path/Dressup/Utils.py: only baseOp() robustness and licence header changed; no preference touched
Path/Op/Gui/Base.py: needsFullSpace() hunk is a layout helper unrelated to start point selection
Path/Op/Gui/Base.py: needsFullSpace() change only affects pages that opt in; Drilling does not
